title: A sharper upper bound on the nonlinearity of balanced Boolean functions in even dimension (paper and Lean 4 proof)
description: For every m ≥ 4, every balanced Boolean function on 2m variables has nonlinearity at most 2^(2m−1) − 2^(m−1) − 4. This answers Open Problem 4 of Lou, Xu and Wang (arXiv:2610.17897) and gives new upper bounds 2012, 8124 and 32636 for n = 12, 14 and 16. The cases n = 8 (116) and n = 10 (492) were first proved by Yuan et al. (IACR ePrint 2026/1687), Lou–Xu–Wang, and Xu–Wang (IACR ePrint 2026/2797); they are reproved here independently. Contains the paper and a complete Lean 4 proof (no Mathlib, no sorry, standard axioms only) with a comparator-checked Challenge/Solution pair. The paper is licensed CC BY 4.0; the code is MIT.
